professionalService.problemSolved: Lets an architect explain to a client how one physical 1:100 study model relates to the spatial scale and lived rooms of the proposed house.
professionalService.serviceOutcome: The same house and contoured site move from card and desk into a materialized exterior/interior visit, reveal a nested model in the study, and return to the original card presentation.
professionalService.decisionValue: Can clarify proportion, site relation and room experience during design discussion. The donor studio CTA and authored house are not evidence of a Rubik project or a verified construction outcome.

evidence.statement: Corrected desktop A→B→A and M01–M14 show one house through card, real, nested model and return.
Donor README describes one parts list, scale dive, lamp-centered turn, two lighting states and return.

continuityInvariants.statement: Card and real house preserve the flat roof, clerestory, balcony, glazing and lower stair on one contoured site.

evidence.statement: Card house at stable A0.
Materialized exterior.
cardHouse and realHouse consume the same houseParts list.

evidence.statement: Card at eye height.

evidence.statement: Small study desk model and +3.20 room label.

continuityInvariants.statement: The return front aligns real roof, balcony, openings and contour board before the card hero and CTA return.

evidence.statement: Real house on desk-scale site during return.
